subproblem.title: Mass upper bound M_W(T) ≤ μ(W) for a representation with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| (parent step 10)
subproblem.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), μ a measure on ℝ^P and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n (MultiVector P n). Assume |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α for every x and every n-covector α, and T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) (Bochner integral) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). Then M_W(T) = T.massOn W ≤ μ(W) for every set W ⊆ ℝ^P.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), T.massOn W ≤ μ W
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof, step 10. The bound is proved for every set W; the parent needs only open W. The case μ(W) = ∞ needs no separate treatment.
Notation: |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α. By definition (Simon 6.2.5; SimonGMT GeometricCurrentOn.massOn), M_W(T) is the supremum in [0, ∞] of ofReal(T ω) over ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn U n W. Such ω are exactly the ω ∈ TestFormOn U n with tsupport ω ⊆ W and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for every x.
1. By sSup_le it suffices to show ofReal(T ω) ≤ μ(W) for every admissible ω. Fix one, and put K := tsupport ω and f(x) := ξ(x)(ω(x)). K is closed, hence Borel, and T(ω) = ∫ f dμ by hypothesis.
2. (Pointwise bound.) For x ∈ K, |f(x)| ≤ |ω(x)| ≤ 1. For x ∉ K, ω(x) = 0 (image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport), hence f(x) = ξ(x)(0) = 0. So ‖f(x)‖ₑ ≤ 1_K(x) for every x.
3. (Chain.) ofReal(T ω) = ofReal(∫ f dμ) ≤ ofReal|∫ f dμ| = ‖∫ f dμ‖ₑ (Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs).
 - ‖∫ f dμ‖ₑ ≤ ∫⁻ ‖f‖ₑ dμ (enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm). This holds for every f, integrable or not, and needs no measurability of ξ.
 - ∫⁻ ‖f‖ₑ dμ ≤ ∫⁻ 1_K dμ = μ(K), by step 2 and lintegral_indicator_one (K measurable).
 - μ(K) ≤ μ(W), since K ⊆ W.
4. Taking the supremum over admissible ω gives M_W(T) ≤ μ(W). ∎
proof_key_steps: Reduce to ofReal(T ω) ≤ μ(W) for each ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn U n W (sSup_le).
|ξ(x)(ω(x))| ≤ |ω(x)| ≤ 1 on tsupport ω, and ξ(x)(ω(x)) = 0 off tsupport ω.
ofReal(∫ f dμ) ≤ ‖∫ f dμ‖ₑ ≤ ∫⁻ ‖f‖ₑ dμ ≤ μ(tsupport ω) ≤ μ(W).

audit.reason: The stronger conclusion for arbitrary W is valid and matches the prose. Each admissible evaluation is bounded by the integral of the indicator of its closed support, then by μ(W). The unconditional integral-norm inequality justifies omitting measurability assumptions on ξ. Taking the defining supremum proves the exact statement.
